headline_marked: [[Iranian officials at Khamenei's funeral will not be targeted]], Trump says, citing need for talks
headline: Iranian officials at Khamenei's funeral will not be targeted, Trump says, citing need for talks
summary: US President Donald Trump stated that Iranian officials attending Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral would not be targeted, emphasizing the need for ongoing US-Iran discussions.
details: US President Donald Trump has stated that Iranian officials attending Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral will not be targeted. He clarified that this decision is based on the necessity for the United States to have people for future discussions with Iran. This information was reported by Iran International on Sunday, July 5, citing American media outlet Axios.

Following the conclusion of Khamenei's farewell ceremonies, discussions between the United States and Iran are scheduled to resume in Pakistan on July 11. This upcoming dialogue signifies a potential path forward for diplomatic engagement between the two nations.

Iran's state media reported that senior clerics, rather than Ayatollah Khamenei's son and current Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, would lead the funeral prayers in Tehran, Qom, and Mashhad. Mojtaba Khamenei or his other brothers were notably absent from any of the arrangements so far.

Ghulam-Ali Haddad Adel, Mojtaba Khamenei's father-in-law, was present as a representative of the Khamenei family. Millions gathered at Tehran's Grand Mosalla complex on Saturday for Ayatollah Khamenei's final farewell. While foreign guests attended a tribute ceremony on Friday, no world leaders were present.

headline: Elephant 'Badshah Bahadur' to be moved to National Zoo by PM's order
summary: The elephant, known as Badshah Bahadur, is being transferred to the National Zoo following a directive from the Prime Minister.
details: Following a directive from the Prime Minister, the elephant named 'Badshah Bahadur' is being moved to the National Zoo.
The transfer is part of a measure to ensure the animal's proper care and management within a specialized facility.
The National Zoo will now be responsible for the overall health and wellbeing of the animal.
caption:
A royal move for Badshah Bahadur! The elephant is heading to the National Zoo by order of the Prime Minister.

Following a directive from the Prime Minister, the elephant named 'Badshah Bahadur' is being moved to the National Zoo.

The transfer is part of a measure to ensure the animal's proper care and management within a specialized facility.

The National Zoo will now be responsible for the overall health and wellbeing of the animal.
